findings.currentLearnerExperience: Privacy table contrasts encryption with consent and transparency; line 320 implies absent consent is enough to establish a violation.
findings.genuineGap: The lawful basis is unspecified; transparency and consent are different questions.
findings.smallestUsefulChange: Replace the blanket consent inference with an applicable-law/basis qualifier; retain the privacy-versus-confidentiality distinction.

sample.en: Encryption restricts access. Privacy also requires an appropriate purpose and lawful basis; consent is one possible basis under the GDPR.
